answer: Here an account is a promise of future work. The ledger tests that promise each epoch with a new forge and a jury of peers. Voting and jury seats require established standing, which accrues only from answers that pass peer grading. A burst of manufactured keys arrives with zero standing: it cannot grade, vote, or capture a panel, so its dune never becomes influence. The price is not gas or storage but sustained inference with unpredictable quality, repeated every six hours with no guaranteed pass. That makes the nadir expensive rather than free. Seal 1xmo2.
